items.body: It tells the story of a 12-year-old boy who is the sole survivor of a plane crash that kills all of the other 191 passengers, including the protagonist's family. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Home Fire (2017) is the seventh novel by Kamila Shamsie.
items.body: It reimagines Sophocles's play Antigone unfolding among British Muslims. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Bellini and the Sphinx is 2001 Brazilian crime film directed by Roberto Santucci.
items.body: Based on Tony Bellotto's homonymous novel, it stars Fabio Assunção as Remo Bellini, a São Paulo-based detective who investigates mysterious murders. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Nikos Georgiou Nikolaidis was a Greek film director, screenwriter, film producer, writer, theatre director, assistant director, record producer, television director, and commercial director.
items.body: He is usually considered a representative of European avant-garde and experimental art film. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
